Name: Name Display Mod
Author: Meoom
Description:
[size=6][b]Name Display Mod[/b][/size]

Displays customizable colored names and monster health bars above all characters, with in-game name editing for NPCs, pets and horses.

[line]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]Name Display[/b]
[list]
[*]Shows names above [b]all characters[/b]: NPCs, monsters, farmhands, other multiplayer players, pets (cat/dog), and horses[/*]
[*]Each category has its own [b]independent color setting[/b][/*]
[*]Horse names only show when [b]not being ridden[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]Monster Health Bars[/b]
[list]
[*]Displays a health bar above every monster[/*]
[*]Shows [b]current health / max health[/b] numerically[/*]
[*]Configurable health bar color[/*]
[/list]
[b]In-Game Name Editing[/b]
[list]
[*]Press [b]F2[/b] (configurable) while hovering over a character to rename them[/*]
[*][b]NPCs[/b]: renaming is a display-only override (saved when the game saves). This is useful when some character names aren't localized in your language — you can force them to display in whatever name and language you prefer. Or just use it to give everyone silly names, we won't judge.[/*]
[*][b]Pets and horses[/b]: renaming actually changes their real name in the save file (not just a display override). Only the main player (farm owner) can do this, and it costs a configurable amount of gold — default 5000g.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Appearance[/b]
[list]
[*]Configurable name [b]Y-offset[/b] (vertical position above the head)[/*]
[*]Configurable name [b]scale[/b] (font size)[/*]
[*]Optional [b]black outline[/b] behind names for better readability[/*]
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Works in both single-player and multiplayer[/*]
[*]Split-screen players share name override settings automatically[/*]
[*]Cross-device multiplayer: each player uses their own settings independently[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

All options are available in-game via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] (optional, but highly recommended).

Settings include:
[list]
[*]Toggle name display for each category (NPCs, monsters, pets, horses, player, other players)[/*]
[*]Color selection for each category (16 preset colors)[/*]
[*]Monster health bar toggle and color[/*]
[*]Name Y-offset, scale, and outline toggle[/*]
[*]Edit name hotkey[/*]
[*]Pet/horse rename gold cost[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[b]Optional[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to access the in-game configuration menu[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]Compatible with most mods, including mod-added NPCs (SVE, RSV, etc.)[/*]
[*]No known conflicts[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]

This mod supports translations. Currently available in:
[list]
[*]English (default)[/*]
[*]Chinese[/*]
[/list]
If you'd like to contribute a translation, feel free to submit a translation file!

[line]

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]

Made by [b]Meoom[/b]
